en:
positional arguments:
  extract (e)     Extract archives
  watch (w)       Manage folder monitoring
  scan (s)        Inspect archives and confirm passwords
  passwords (pw)  Show extraction passwords
  config (cfg)    Show or validate config
  daemon (d)      Manage the background process
  doctor (doc)    Check the installation
  version (ver)   Show the version

options:
  -h              Show help
en.extract:
positional arguments:
  paths                    Input files or folders

options:
  -h                       Show help
  -j                       Output JSON
  -v                       Show detailed output
  -npa                     Exit immediately when finished
  -pa                      Wait for a key press before exit
  -R                       Discover files recursively in input directories
  -d                       Discover archives only through full embedded scanning, including nested rounds
  -p PASSWORD              Archive password; repeatable
  -P PASSWORD_FILE         Password file; one password per line
  -a                       Enter passwords interactively
  -r RECURSIVE_EXTRACT     Extraction rounds: positive integer, * unlimited, ? prompt
  -c ARCHIVE_CLEANUP_MODE  Source archives: d delete, r recycle, k keep
  -o OUTPUT_DIR            Output root; defaults to the current directory
  -f                       Flatten a single top-level directory
  -nf                      Preserve the extracted directory structure
en.watch:
positional arguments:
  enable (ea)   Enable monitoring
  disable (da)  Disable monitoring
  add           Add watched folders
  remove (rm)   Remove watched folders
  list (ls)     List watched folders
  reload (rl)   Reload the watch service
  relog (rlg)   Rebuild logs
  status (st)   Show watch service status

options:
  -h            Show help
  -j            Output JSON
  -v            Show detailed output
  -npa          Exit immediately when finished
  -pa           Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch add:
positional arguments:
  paths          Folders to add or remove

options:
  -h             Show help
  -j             Output JSON
  -v             Show detailed output
  -npa           Exit immediately when finished
  -pa            Wait for a key press before exit
  -o OUTPUT_DIR  Watched folder output root
  -R             Discover files recursively in input directories
  -d             Discover archives in added folders through full embedded scanning
en.watch remove:
positional arguments:
  paths  Folders to add or remove

options:
  -h     Show help
  -j     Output JSON
  -v     Show detailed output
  -npa   Exit immediately when finished
  -pa    Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch list:
options:
  -h    Show help
  -j    Output JSON
  -v    Show detailed output
  -npa  Exit immediately when finished
  -pa   Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch reload:
options:
  -h    Show help
  -j    Output JSON
  -v    Show detailed output
  -npa  Exit immediately when finished
  -pa   Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch relog:
options:
  -h    Show help
  -j    Output JSON
  -v    Show detailed output
  -npa  Exit immediately when finished
  -pa   Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch status:
options:
  -h    Show help
  -j    Output JSON
  -v    Show detailed output
  -npa  Exit immediately when finished
  -pa   Wait for a key press before exit
en.scan:
positional arguments:
  paths             Files or folders to scan

options:
  -h                Show help
  -j                Output JSON
  -v                Show detailed output
  -npa              Exit immediately when finished
  -pa               Wait for a key press before exit
  -R                Discover files recursively in input directories
  -d                Discover archives only through full embedded scanning, including nested rounds
  -p PASSWORD       Archive password; repeatable
  -P PASSWORD_FILE  Password file; one password per line
  -a                Enter passwords interactively
en.passwords:
options:
  -h                Show help
  -j                Output JSON
  -p PASSWORD       Archive password; repeatable
  -P PASSWORD_FILE  Password file; one password per line
  -a                Enter passwords interactively
en.config:
positional arguments:
  show      Show effective config
  validate  Validate config, rules, and schemas

options:
  -h        Show help
  -j        Output JSON
en.daemon start:
options:
  -h    Show help
  -j    Output JSON
  -v    Show detailed output
  -npa  Exit immediately when finished
  -pa   Wait for a key press before exit
  -nt   Hide the tray icon
en.watch enable:
options:
  -h    Show help
  -j    Output JSON
  -v    Show detailed output
  -npa  Exit immediately when finished
  -pa   Wait for a key press before exit
en.watch disable:
options:
  -h    Show help
  -j    Output JSON
  -v    Show detailed output
  -npa  Exit immediately when finished
  -pa   Wait for a key press before exit
en.daemon startup:
positional arguments:
  action  enable: enable autostart; disable: disable autostart; status: show status

options:
  -h      Show help
  -j      Output JSON
  -v      Show detailed output
  -npa    Exit immediately when finished
  -pa     Wait for a key press before exit
en.daemon:
positional arguments:
  start    Start the background process
  stop     Stop the background process
  startup  Manage Windows autostart

options:
  -h       Show help
  -j       Output JSON

zh:
位置参数:
  extract (e)     解压压缩包
  watch (w)       管理目录监控
  scan (s)        扫描归档并确认密码
  passwords (pw)  查看解压密码列表
  config (cfg)    查看或校验配置
  daemon (d)      管理后台进程
  doctor (doc)    检查安装环境
  version (ver)   查看版本号

选项:
  -h              显示帮助
zh.extract:
位置参数:
  paths                    输入文件或目录

选项:
  -h                       显示帮助
  -j                       输出 JSON
  -v                       显示详细信息
  -npa                     命令结束后直接退出
  -pa                      退出前等待按键
  -R                       递归发现输入目录中的文件
  -d                       仅通过完整嵌入扫描发现压缩包，含递归轮次
  -p PASSWORD              解压密码，可重复指定
  -P PASSWORD_FILE         密码文件，每行一个密码
  -a                       交互输入密码
  -r RECURSIVE_EXTRACT     解压轮数：正整数，* 无限，? 询问
  -c ARCHIVE_CLEANUP_MODE  原压缩包处理：d 删除，r 回收站，k 保留
  -o OUTPUT_DIR            输出根目录，默认当前目录
  -f                       扁平化单一顶层目录
  -nf                      保留解压目录结构
zh.watch:
位置参数:
  enable (ea)   启用监控
  disable (da)  禁用监控
  add           添加监控目录
  remove (rm)   移除监控目录
  list (ls)     列出监控目录
  reload (rl)   重新加载监控服务
  relog (rlg)   重建日志
  status (st)   查看监控服务状态

选项:
  -h            显示帮助
  -j            输出 JSON
  -v            显示详细信息
  -npa          命令结束后直接退出
  -pa           退出前等待按键

  -j             输出 JSON

  -o OUTPUT_DIR  监控目录的输出根目录

  -d             通过完整嵌入扫描发现新增目录中的压缩包
